editorial.blurb: Royal Africana Lounge brings authentic Nigerian and Cameroonian flavors to life with dishes like jollof rice, grilled tilapia, and traditional soups that keep devoted customers traveling from across Chicago.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for your dish to be made spicy if you want real heat—the kitchen tends toward milder preparations by default, and the jollof rice with goat is a standout that rewards the request.
